semantics.path_rule: Paths normalized only for locator comparison; semantic identities remain independent.
semantics.json_rule: JSON parser/writer preserves Contract Format semantics and ordered arrays.
semantics.sort_rule: Sorting may stabilize presentation only where order is non-semantic.
semantics.write_rule: Atomic temp+replace strategy recommended for commits.

invariants.rule: Toolchain code, scans, indexes, reports and generated artifacts remain implementation/evidence surfaces; they never become canonical semantic authority unless an explicit accepted canonical definition says so.
Every toolchain execution binds exact bootstrap/source/profile/input revisions and must not resolve ambiguity through filesystem order, newest-wins, mtime, fuzzy names or UI layout.
